note: Piper voice (public domain, LJ Speech). `say` is the spoken form; `text` is the caption shown in the .srt.

lines.text: Debloat hides Google's AI Overview and AI Mode, in Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
lines.say: Debloat hides Google's A.I. Overview, and A.I. Mode. In Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.

lines.text: This is a regular Google search. The AI answer pushes the results down.
lines.say: This is a regular Google search. The A.I. answer pushes the results down.

lines.text: Turn on AI features in the side panel, and it's gone. No reload needed.
lines.say: Turn on A.I. features in the side panel, and it's gone. No reload needed.

lines.text: Prefer to keep it close? Collapse it to a slim bar, and open it with one click.
lines.say: Prefer to keep it close? Collapse it to a slim bar, and open it with one click.

lines.text: Need it back for a while? Pause Debloat for an hour.
lines.say: Need it back for a while? Pause Debloat for an hour.

lines.text: It also hides sponsored content, shopping tools, Copilot prompts and telemetry.
lines.say: It also hides sponsored content, shopping tools, Copilot prompts, and telemetry.

lines.text: Debloat. Free, open source, and no data collected.
lines.say: Debloat. Free, open source, and no data collected.
